name: MetalpriceAPI
tagline: Real-time and historical precious metal and commodity exchange rates
description: MetalpriceAPI provides real-time and historical pricing for gold, silver, platinum, palladium, and other metals plus commodity FX-style rates. Developers query live spot prices, convert between metal and currency pairs, and pull time-series or fluctuation data via a simple REST API with a free tier for lightweight gold/silver apps.

auth.details: API key via api_key query parameter (or Authorization header); self-serve signup for free and paid keys

pricing.free_tier_limits: 100 requests/month on the Free plan, with daily data updates. Basic is a paid plan with 10,000 requests/month and 10-minute updates.
pricing.paid_plans: Paid plans from Pro upward with higher monthly request quotas and more features

rate_limits: not published beyond plan request quotas
use_cases: get current gold and silver spot prices in USD
convert a metal amount to fiat currency
fetch historical precious metal rates for a date
track metal price fluctuations over a period
power a jewelry or bullion pricing display
